name: Ane Ane Double Saimin 2 ~Kyonyuu Onna Joushi Chikan, Kyonyuu Hitozuma Netori, Kichiku Nakadashi de Haramasete Yaru!~
original_name: 姉姉Ｗ催眠２ ～巨乳女上司痴漢、巨乳人妻寝取り、鬼畜中出しで孕ませてやる！～
source:
The protagnost is a failing businessman that is currently employed by his sister-in-law, Fuyuka. However, he spends his days being scorned and despised. Moreover, he's also a freeloader at his brother's house and treated badly by his other sister-in-law, Natsuki.

One day, while investigating the suspicious "YAMI Site", he comes across a hyponsis device. Using this, he is going to change his life.

[Translated from [url=http://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/aneanew2/index.html#Story]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位失败的商人，目前受雇于他的嫂子冬香。然而，他的日子却在被人蔑视和鄙视中度过。而且，他还在哥哥家里贪图便宜，受到了另一个嫂子夏希的虐待。

某天，他在调查可疑的“YAMI站点”时，偶然发现了一种催眠装置。利用这个，他将改变他的生活。

【翻译自[url=http://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/aneanew2/index.html#Story]官网[/url]】
